policy: Per exact upstream model string, only reported levels present in this allowlist receive an ordered path rank. The vendor documentation supports relative effort order within that model/provider; values do not imply equal compute across different models/providers. Unmapped, null, or adaptive settings remain standalone points.

gpt-6-astra.rationale: OpenAI lists GPT-6 Astra among its reasoning models, describes model-dependent effort values and increasing effort semantics; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Astra series.

gpt-5-6-sol.rationale: OpenAI documents model-dependent low/medium/high/xhigh/max effort settings and higher-effort semantics; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Sol series.

gpt-5-6-terra.rationale: OpenAI documents model-dependent low/medium/high/xhigh/max effort settings and higher-effort semantics; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Terra series.

gpt-5-6-luna.rationale: OpenAI documents model-dependent low/medium/high/xhigh/max effort settings and higher-effort semantics; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Luna series.

gpt-5-5.rationale: OpenAI documents lower-to-higher model-dependent reasoning effort settings; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed GPT-5.5 series.

claude-opus-5.rationale: Anthropic describes stepping down/up across low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Opus series.

claude-fable-5.rationale: Anthropic describes stepping down/up across low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Fable series.

claude-opus-4-8.rationale: Anthropic describes stepping down/up across low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Opus series.

claude-sonnet-5.rationale: Anthropic describes stepping down/up across low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; the exact labels/path are restricted to this source's observed Sonnet series.

gemini-3-8-flash.rationale: Google lists low, medium, and high levels for Gemini 3.8 Flash; only those exact observed labels are ordered in this series.

gemini-3-7-flash.rationale: Google lists low, medium, and high levels for Gemini 3.7 Flash; only those exact observed labels are ordered in this series.

grok-4-6.rationale: xAI lists Grok 4.6 low, medium, high, and xhigh in increasing reasoning depth; this map does not borrow max from another provider.
